entities.summary: Marcus Goodman Raskin was an American progressive social critic, political activist, author, and philosopher. He was the co-founder, with Richard Barnet, of the progressive think tank the Institute for Policy Studies in Washington, D.C. He was also a professor of public policy at The George Washington University's School of Public Policy and Public Administration.
